strip.title: Appraisal summary report
strip.busy: Generating the report. The new file will appear in the list below
strip.timeout: No new file found within 60 seconds. The job may still be running. Refresh this page later.
strip.timeoutNotified: No new file found within 60 seconds. The job may still be running. Refresh this page later. Do not click again — it notifies the source system again.

dialog.fileInvalid: Please choose a file (JPG, PNG or PDF)
dialog.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. The customer sent a corrected certificate after approval

replace.title: Replace file
replace.note: The old file will be removed and its name kept in the history

delete.title: Delete document
delete.warning: The file will be removed from this appraisal and cannot be recovered. Only the file name and the reason are kept in the history.

regenerate.title: Regenerate the appraisal summary report?
regenerate.intro: The system will build the summary from the current data and attach it as a new file. The old file is kept.
regenerate.useWhen1: Use it when the report generated at approval failed
regenerate.useWhen2: Or when data corrected after closing makes the existing report wrong
regenerate.notifyLabel: Notify the source system ({{system}}) to fetch the documents again
regenerate.notifyHint: Once the report is attached, the source system ({{system}}) fetches the current valuation book and summary report again. If you still need to attach or replace those files, do that first. Other document types are not sent.
regenerate.noSource: There is no source system to notify for this appraisal

notify.title: Notify the source system ({{system}}) to fetch the documents again?
notify.intro: The source system ({{system}}) is told the appraisal result is ready and fetches the current valuation book and summary report. No new summary report is generated.
notify.note: Use it after attaching or replacing the valuation book / summary report yourself. Other document types are not sent.

toast.noExternalSource: This appraisal has no source system to notify. Refresh this page and try again.
